svg.title: inside radius rz. This uses a copied actual branch, not a new minimizer. The full entry is plotted fine moment direct-summed with Z, and its linear entry is xlin ⊕zlin. For logarithmic inputs bounded by H, combine the plotted comparison already proved with the preceding inequality for Z: set M = (Cx + Cz)H and W = CxH widen(R, H, widthtop) + CzH2. Then each linear entry has norm at most M and each entry-minus-linear-entry has norm at most W, simultaneously in the two kinds of row. For H of rate −1/2 and R = till(x) they have rates −1/2, −1. Predictor covariance and curvature conjugation give gauge covariance, and the union of cutoffstencil, predictor reach and coarse root link gives protected-hull locality. These establish the entry-near and entry-locality inputs used next.
